name: Activity Directors: four plain notes over 21 days
note: Plain text on purpose: no pictures, no buttons, at most one link, written the way one person writes to another. Merge fields: first_name (falls back to 'there'), facility, city, sender_name, postal_address, unsubscribe_line. Every email carries the sender's real postal address, an easy way to opt out, and a line saying it is an advertisement (the U.S. CAN-SPAM rules). scripts/check-outreach.mjs fails the build if any of that is missing, or if a line makes a claim the site does not make.

steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

My name is {{sender_name}}, and I'm from {{sender_place}}. I made a tool called Cognicopia for people who plan activities for residents living with memory loss, and I thought of {{facility}}.

You tell it a little about a resident (where they grew up, their work, the music they loved) and it prints a large-print, black-and-white packet made just for them. A few things people like:

- Made for grown-ups: no childish clip art, nothing that quizzes anyone.
- Music, movies and sayings from the 1940s through the 1980s.
- Big, bold print that is easy to read and easy on the toner.
- Touch activities for a tablet, with no wrong answers.
- It runs in a web browser, and no resident information leaves your computer.

The first 25 packets are free, with no credit card and no sign-up. I'm local, so I would be glad to drop off a printed sample or answer questions. Just reply here, or write to me at Cognicopia@outlook.com.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia

{{footer}}

subjects: A sample packet, in case it helps
steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Just a friendly follow-up from {{sender_name}} in {{sender_place}}, in case my first note got buried.

Here is a sample packet, five pages made for a made-up resident, so you can see the style and the print size without signing up for anything:

https://cognicopia.org/assets/samples/cognicopia-sample-packet.pdf

If it looks like something your residents would enjoy, the first 25 packets are free, with no credit card and no sign-up.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia
Cognicopia@outlook.com

{{footer}}

subjects: Trying this with a few residents first
steps.body:
Hello {{first_name}},

Some communities like to try something with a few residents for a month before anyone is asked to approve it. I wrote a short plan for that: four weeks of things to try, what to write down, and answers to the questions an administrator or IT usually asks.

https://cognicopia.org/pilot.html

The tool does not need an install or a login, and I am happy to help if anything is unclear. Reply here, or write to Cognicopia@outlook.com.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia

{{footer}}

Hello {{first_name}},

This is my last note, so I will not fill your inbox. If activity packets are not a priority right now, I understand completely.

If a colleague at another community might find it useful, you are welcome to pass along cognicopia.org. If you do want to talk, Cognicopia@outlook.com reaches me directly.

Thank you for the work you do with your residents.

Warm regards,
{{sender_name}}
Cognicopia

{{footer}}
